description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange Effective from 16.09.2019 to 22.09.2019
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It represents a regulatory framework for customs operations, specifically governing how foreign currency conversions are handled for customs purposes. The content involves legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
